blocks.text: Zaraat mein genetic engineering ka matlab hai kisi jaandaar ke DNA mein khaas genes daal kar, nikaal kar ya badal kar tabdeeli karna. Is se genetically modified (GM) fasalein banayi jaati hain jin mein matloob khoobiyan (desired traits) hoti hain.
Scientists pehle aik mufeed gene dhoondte hain jis mein matloob khoobi ho (maslan kisi bacterium ka woh gene jo keeron se bachata hai), jaise khushk-saali bardasht karna (drought tolerance) waghera.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam baen se daen teeron se jure: 1. Identification, DNA double helix par magnifier, tag Identify; 2. Isolation, qainchi DNA ka tukra kaat'ti hai, label Vector, tag Snip; 3. Insertion, gene aur syringe use cell mein daalti hai, tag Move; 4. Expression, patton aur surkh phalon wala paudha, tag Grow.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ke chaar qadam: 1. Identification (pehchan): mufeed gene dhoondna. 2. Isolation (alag karna): gene ko DNA se kaat kar nikaalna. 3. Insertion (daalna): gene ko vector (carrier) ke zariye paude ke cell mein daalna. 4. Expression (izhar): paude ka naya gene kaam karta hai aur paude mein nayi khoobi aa jaati hai.

Jis gene se khaas khoobi aati hai, use us jaandaar se alag (isolate) kiya jata hai. Phir yeh gene gene gun ya carrier bacterium (gene pohanchane wala bacterium) ke zariye nishana paude ke genome mein daal diya jata hai, taake woh paude ke DNA mein “sil” jaye. Phir paude ke cells is naye gene ka izhar (expression) karte hain, aur paude mein nayi khoobi aa jaati hai. Ab yeh tabdeel shuda paude aisa naya protein banata hai jo pehle nahi bana sakta tha.

GM fasalon mein pests aur bimariyon ke khilaf behtar mazahmat (resistance), herbicides bardasht karne ki salahiyat aur zyada ghizaiyat (nutritional value) ho sakti hai. Is se paidawar barh sakti hai aur kuch pesticides ki zaroorat kam ho sakti hai. Maslan BT-Cotton apna pesticide khud banati hai, is liye chemical spray kam karna parta hai. Golden Rice mein beta-carotene (jis se jism Vitamin A banata hai) daala gaya hai taake ghareeb mulkon mein andhapan (blindness) roka ja sake.

Is ke khadshaat (concerns) bhi hain: GM genes jangli paudon tak phail sakte hain (outcrossing); “superweeds” ban sakti hain, jab herbicide se na marne wale genes cross-pollination ke zariye GM fasal se jangli jari-bootiyon mein chale jayein aur unhein maarna na-mumkin ho jaye. Is se aise keere bhi paida hote hain jin par dawa asar na kare (resistant insects), aur insaani sehat aur biodiversity (jaandaron ki rangarangi) par lambe arse ke asraat ka bhi khatra hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Fungicides ke istemal ke do bare zarai faide batayein (fasal ki sehat ya paidawar se jor kar).
blocks.explanation: 1) Yeh fasalon ko phaphoond ki bimariyon se bacha kar paudon ko sehatmand rakhte hain. 2) Is tarah paidawar barhti hai aur fasal ya ghalla zaya hone se bachta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Jab pisa hua limestone (CaCO₃) jheel ya khet mein acid rain ke sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) ko neutralize karne ke liye dala jata hai, to hone wale reaction ki balanced equation likhein.
c) Do khaas khoobiyan (traits) batayein jo scientists nayi fasalon mein climate change ke muqable ke liye paida karna chahte hain.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: khushk-saali bardasht (drought tolerance), garmi bardasht (heat tolerance), selaab ya paani mein doobna bardasht (flood tolerance), namkeen mitti bardasht (salt tolerance).

items: Genetic engineering: DNA mein genes daalna, nikaalna ya badalna; GM fasalein.
Qadam: gene ki pehchan, alag karna, gene gun ya bacterium se daalna, izhar.
Faide: mazahmat, herbicide bardasht, ghizaiyat (BT-Cotton, Golden Rice).
Khadshaat: outcrossing, superweeds, resistant insects, sehat aur biodiversity par asar.
